instruction: Move the title placeholder to the bottom of the slide on Slide 2.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the title placeholder (PlaceHolder 1) to the bottom position on Slide 2. The evaluator calculates the expected bottom position as slide_height - shape_height - margin and checks if the title's top position matches. Verified by analyzing the PPTX structure: Slide 2 has PlaceHolder 1 at index 0 with title 'NFC'.

llm_judge_reasons: Position calculation uses hardcoded margin (274680 EMUs) without justification - this value may not match actual slide layout margins
Calculation depends on shape.height from result file, meaning if user resizes the title while moving it, expected position changes unpredictably
Very large tolerance (100000 EMUs ≈ 3.5mm) may accept positions that are not truly 'at the bottom' of the slide
No verification that title was actually moved - would pass even if title was already at bottom position originally
Hardcoded margin value may not work correctly for different PowerPoint templates or slide layouts
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Read the original PPTX file to determine the actual margin/spacing used in the slide layout, rather than using hardcoded value
Use the original shape height for calculation instead of result shape height to handle resize cases
Reduce tolerance to a more reasonable value (e.g., 20000-50000 EMUs) for more precise position verification
Consider reading original position to verify that the shape was actually moved (compare original vs result)
Add validation that shape is actually a title placeholder (check placeholder type, not just has_text_frame)
